pages.title: 01 Models, applications and agents
pages.summary: Translation, summarization and code generation can all be expressed as an input and an output. A large language model processes and generates language; an application connects it to a task.

blocks.text: Text in, text out
Compare three text interfaces: translation, a meeting table and a generated program. Start from this shared operation and unpack how it works.
A large language model processes and generates language; an application connects it to a task.

blocks.alt: Text in, text out

lines.zh: 输入：将价格从小到大排

caption.zh: 本课的例子从这些输入与输出展开。
caption.en: We will follow concrete inputs and outputs throughout the class.

beats.zh: 大语言模型，简称LLM，处理和生成语言。这里输入中文，按翻译要求生成英文。
beats.en: A large language model, or LLM, processes and generates language. A translation request takes Chinese and returns English.

beats.zh: 换成会议记录，模型把句子整理成事项、负责人和日期。输入材料与要求一起决定输出内容。
beats.en: With meeting notes, it organizes sentences into tasks, owners and dates. The material and instructions both shape the output.

beats.zh: 代码是给计算机执行的指令。模型先生成程序，运行后才得到排序数字。
beats.en: Code gives a computer instructions. A model generates the program; running it produces the sorted numbers.

blocks.text: What are an LLM, an agent and an application?

LLM means Large Language Model: a learned numerical model that computes output from input. An application handles files, conversation, model calls and presentation. An agent is a system that chooses actions from observations while pursuing a goal. An app may use one model call or organize several agents.

Generating a draft from a request is one call. Searching for sources, returning them to the model and searching again for missing information is a sequence organized by software. Both can use the same model.

blocks.alt: What are an LLM, an agent and an application?

caption.zh: 这里画的是组成关系；后面会展开实际的调用往返。
caption.en: These are components; later figures show the request and response paths.

beats.zh: 应用是你操作的软件：收集要求和文件，显示结果，也能调用工具。
beats.en: The app collects requests and files, displays output and can call tools.

beats.zh: 模型是生成部分：根据应用送入的文字，计算接下来写什么，再交回应用。
beats.en: The model computes what to write from supplied text and returns it to the app.

beats.zh: 模型需要在真实机器上运行。图里的芯片执行数字运算；应用、模型和机器共同完成一次回答。
beats.en: A model runs on a physical machine. Chips perform numerical operations; app, model and machine together deliver a response.

pages.title: 02 Tokens and numerical representations
pages.summary: Tokens are pieces processed by a model; a piece can be smaller than a word. The tokenizer determines the pieces.

blocks.text: Text becomes tokens, then IDs

Text must become numerical input. Treat a token simply as a piece of text. Raincoat is one English word, but our illustration splits it into rain and coat. A tokenizer divides text and assigns IDs; the model looks up a numerical vector for each ID. An ID is a catalog reference. The vector is a learned representation, not a list of hand-written definitions.
The tokenizer determines the pieces.

blocks.alt: Text becomes tokens, then IDs

result.zh: 片段 → 数字编号 → 模型计算

caption.zh: rain / coat、编号和数值为切分示意；实际切法由具体分词器决定。
caption.en: Pieces, IDs and values are illustrative; an actual tokenizer determines the split.

beats.zh: raincoat 是英语里的雨衣。分词器是把文字切成片段的程序；每个片段叫一个 Token。
beats.en: Raincoat is one English word. A tokenizer is a program that divides text into pieces; each piece is a token.

beats.zh: 示例先切出 rain。一个词可以有多个 Token，Token 不固定等于一个单词或汉字。
beats.en: Our example first takes rain. A word can contain several tokens; a token is not always one word or Chinese character.

beats.zh: 再切出 coat。词表给每个片段一个编号；编号像目录号，本身不表示这个词有多大或多重要。
beats.en: Next comes coat. A vocabulary gives each piece an ID, like a catalog number; a larger ID does not mean greater importance.

beats.zh: 模型按编号查出一串数值，再用这些数参与运算。这串数叫数值表示，也常叫向量。
beats.en: The model uses the ID to look up a list of numbers for computation. This numerical representation is also called a vector.

pages.title: 03 Autoregression and Transformers
pages.summary: A token is a tokenizer-defined piece, not necessarily one character. Transformer organizes computation; autoregression feeds new pieces back into the sequence.

blocks.text: Transformer is an architecture; autoregression is a generation scheme

A token is a tokenizer-defined piece, not necessarily one character. Its ID selects a numerical representation, and Transformer computations produce a distribution for the next piece. Transformer describes the computation architecture; autoregression describes feeding previous output back into generation. They are different concepts.

Assume the example 吃好了 is split into 吃 / 好 / 了. After 吃, generate 好; then use 吃好 to generate 了. The split is illustrative. A long response repeats a prediction operation rather than retrieving a complete stored article.

blocks.alt: Transformer is an architecture; autoregression is a generation scheme

detail.zh: 下一轮使用更长的前文

caption.zh: 箭头表示数据如何进入下一轮。
caption.en: Arrows show information feeding the next round.

beats.zh: 已有文字是 The sky is。每一步都以上一步已经有的文字为起点。
beats.en: The text so far is The sky is. Each step starts with the text already available.

beats.zh: 模型根据这段前文计算下一 Token 的概率；图中的模型重复使用，不需要每写一个词就重新训练。
beats.en: The model computes next-token probabilities from the prefix. It is reused, without retraining for each new word.

beats.zh: 这次选中 blue，意思是蓝色。它是新增的一小块，还不是整篇回答。
beats.en: This draw selects blue, one new piece rather than the whole response.

beats.zh: 把 blue 接到前文后，就得到 The sky is blue。再按同样步骤继续；这个用已有输出接着生成的过程叫自回归。
beats.en: Appending blue gives The sky is blue. Repeat the same steps: generating from previous output is called autoregressive generation.

blocks.text: Attention: combine information using weights

Earlier tokens are not merely a row of unrelated numbers. A position combines information from context. 'Ride it' relates to the bicycle within weather context. Attention compares position representations to compute mixing weights, then combines values. We isolate the multiplication and addition using preset 80/20 weights, not a fixed grammatical rule.
Attention combines information from different context positions.

blocks.alt: Attention: combine information using weights

caption.zh: 自行车/天气、两维数值和 80%/20% 都是教学算例；不是实测注意力。
caption.en: Bicycle/weather labels, two-number values and 80%/20% weights are a teaching example, not measured attention.

beats.zh: 读“我买了自行车，周末下雨，想骑它”时，“它”与自行车有关。模型先把各处信息写成数值列表。
beats.en: In 'I bought a bicycle; it may rain; I want to ride it', it refers to the bicycle. The model represents positions as lists of numbers.

beats.zh: 模型比较当前位置与前文的数值表示，算出组合权重。这里给定80%和20%，只演示后面的乘加。
beats.en: A model compares position representations to compute mixing weights. Preset 80/20 weights here isolate the following multiplication and addition.

beats.zh: 每组数分别乘自己的权重，再把对应位置相加。交换权重后，哪部分影响更大也跟着变；结果继续参与生成。
beats.en: Multiply each value list by its weight, then add matching entries. Swapping weights changes each contribution; the combined result feeds later computation.

pages.title: 04 Diffusion generation and AIGC
pages.summary: Autoregression appends pieces to a sequence. Denoising updates a state; autoregression appends a sequence. Both use learned parameters.

blocks.text: Autoregressive text and diffusion update different objects

Autoregression appends pieces to a sequence. Diffusion starts from a noisy state and repeatedly predicts updates that lead toward an image. One grows a sequence; the other changes a state. Vision can also be autoregressive, and diffusion can serve other modalities: these are not exclusive text/image categories.
Both use a trained model. Changing the generated state differs from changing learned parameters during training. Track the state along the arrows before asking whether the model itself changed.

blocks.alt: Autoregressive text and diffusion update different objects

caption.zh: 潜空间扩散的过程示意；中间状态不是模型实测结果，解码后才是可显示图像。
caption.en: Latent-diffusion process illustration; intermediate states are not measured model output, and decoding produces the visible image.

beats.zh: 噪声是随机数形成的杂点，不是藏着一张照片。文字条件说明要画什么，例如绿色遮阳篷的咖啡店。
beats.en: Noise is a pattern of random numbers, not a hidden photograph. The text condition describes the requested café with a green awning.

beats.zh: 训练时用加噪图像学习预测噪声或更新。生成时模型读当前状态、文字与步数，给出本轮更新；这里示意为−0.20。
beats.en: Training uses noisy images to learn noise or updates. During generation the model reads state, text and timestep; −0.20 illustrates one update.

beats.zh: 按更新改变当前状态，再送回同一个模型。逐轮得到更符合条件的状态；回箭头表示继续改这份状态。
beats.en: Apply the update and feed the new state to the same model. Iteration moves it toward the condition; the return arrow carries the updated state.

beats.zh: 在这类潜空间扩散中，状态是压缩的数值表示。解码器把最终表示转为能显示的像素，才得到画面。
beats.en: In this latent-diffusion example, states are compressed numerical representations. A decoder converts the final representation into visible pixels.

blocks.text: Several models can contribute to one short film

A single image is one part of making a fifteen-second film. A script specifies scenes and narration; visuals and audio are organized in time. The three views illustrate one scene rather than unrelated images. Multimodality concerns text, images and sound; workflow connects them into a finished artifact.
AIGC means AI-generated content.

blocks.alt: Several models can contribute to one short film

caption.zh: 有的模型跨多模态；有的应用组合多个专用模型。
caption.en: Some models are multimodal; applications can also combine specialized models.

beats.zh: AIGC 是 AI 生成内容的缩写。先写 15 秒短片的场景、镜头和旁白，给后面各步明确材料。
beats.en: AIGC means AI-generated content. A 15-second script specifies scenes, shots and narration for subsequent steps.

beats.zh: 画面按 0、5、10 秒排列。视频是连续的图像序列，镜头推进时，要保持咖啡店与前后画面相连。
beats.en: Visuals are ordered at 0, 5 and 10 seconds. Video is an image sequence, with café identity and motion kept continuous.

beats.zh: 声音用时间上的波形表示。把旁白放在合适的位置、调整长度，让声音和画面对齐。
beats.en: A waveform represents audio over time. Place and trim narration so its timing aligns with the visuals.

beats.zh: 剪辑把各片段排进同一条时间线，再导出完整短片。多模态指处理文字、图像或声音等不同形式的信息。
beats.en: Editing arranges clips on one timeline and exports a film. Multimodal means handling forms such as text, images and audio.

pages.title: 05 Prompts: from instructions to templates
pages.summary: A prompt states the task for the current call. An article needs a background paragraph, then time, place and how to join.

blocks.text: Prompts: turn “write an article” into explicit conditions

A prompt states the task for the current call. Prompt engineering develops and compares task instructions: the goal, audience, material and output structure. A template fixes recurring requirements and fills in the current subject. It cannot supply missing facts by itself.

For example: “Write a 300-character introduction for first-time attendees. Paragraph one explains the background; paragraph two gives time, location and how to join. Use the supplied notice.” The structure, length, audience and evidence are explicit. The actual notice must still be supplied.

blocks.alt: Prompts: turn “write an article” into explicit conditions

lines.zh: 第二段：时间与参加方式

lines.en: Use the notice for two paragraphs

beats.zh: 帮我写文章。；主题、受众与材料？
beats.en: Write an article.; Subject, audience, material?

beats.zh: 面向首次参加者；第一段：活动背景；第二段：时间与参加方式
beats.en: For first-time attendees; Paragraph 1: background; Paragraph 2: when/how to join

beats.zh: 通知：周四 14:00；地点：报告厅；根据通知整理两段
beats.en: Notice: Thursday 14:00; Location: auditorium; Use the notice for two paragraphs

caption.zh: 模板规定结构，实际通知提供事实；下一步把这些材料组织成上下文。
caption.en: The template specifies structure; the notice supplies facts. Next assemble the material as context.

items.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents

pages.title: 06 Context: supply the material for this call
pages.summary: Context is what a call actually receives: instructions, relevant dialogue, the notice, retrieved passages and tool results. Instructions state the task; context supplies what this call can actually use.

blocks.text: Context: what information accompanies the instruction?

Context is what a call actually receives: instructions, relevant dialogue, the notice, retrieved passages and tool results. Context engineering selects and organizes that information within a finite window. Learned parameters, an external database and the current context are distinct. External material becomes available to a call only after it is supplied.

In the event example, the prompt asks for two paragraphs; context supplies the real date, venue, registration rules and audience background. Repeating the audience description does not replace a missing date. RAG retrieves material before including it in generation.

blocks.alt: Context: what information accompanies the instruction?

caption.zh: 只画本次调用的信息组成。
caption.en: The information assembled for one call.

beats.zh: 一次调用是把输入送给模型再接收结果。先放入要做什么的任务说明。
beats.en: A call sends input and receives a result. First supply the task instructions.

beats.zh: 再选入相关对话；界面里保存的历史未必都发送。
beats.en: Select relevant conversation; stored history need not all be sent.

beats.zh: 应用读出文件或工具结果，实际放入这次输入。
beats.en: The app reads files or tool results and actually supplies their content.

beats.zh: 这些信息组装为一次输入；选择和组织它们就是上下文工程。
beats.en: Assemble the input: selecting and organizing its information is context engineering.

blocks.text: RAG: retrieve material, then answer

A policy collection may span hundreds of pages while the question asks only for an expense deadline. Retrieve relevant passages before supplying the question and evidence. Retrieval finds; generation phrases an answer. The fifth of next month comes from the policy passage. A changed passage can inform a new answer without retraining it into the model.
Retrieval connects external information to generation.

blocks.alt: RAG: retrieve material, then answer

caption.zh: 示例公司的资料问答流程。RAG = retrieval-augmented generation。
caption.en: A fictional company example. RAG means retrieval-augmented generation.

beats.zh: 用户问报销最晚什么时候交。系统先用这个问题查公司制度；检索就是从资料中找相关内容。
beats.en: The user asks for an expense deadline. The system first searches company policy; retrieval finds relevant source material.

beats.zh: 检索找到“次月 5 日前提交”这一段。现在得到的是原文片段，还没有生成给用户的回答。
beats.en: Retrieval finds 'submit by the fifth of next month'. This is a source passage, not yet the generated user response.

beats.zh: 应用把问题和找到的片段一起送给模型；模型本次因此读到了这条制度。
beats.en: The app supplies the question and passage together, making this policy available to the model for the call.

beats.zh: 模型根据片段组织答案。RAG 是检索增强生成的缩写：先找资料，再带着资料生成。
beats.en: The model answers using the passage. RAG means retrieval-augmented generation: retrieve material, then generate with it.

pages.title: 07 Tools, environments and harnesses
pages.summary: The text “change the title” does not edit a file. An executor reads, writes, searches and queries; observations enter the next model call.

blocks.text: What does calling Word or a Linux command mean?

The text “change the title” does not edit a file. Software must expose a tool such as document.set_title, or a terminal tool that executes a command on Linux. Tool descriptions specify names, arguments and purpose. An executor performs the operation and returns its result.

A Word tool may manipulate document objects, while a Linux tool may read files, search text or run a converter. The model must use the interface it is actually given. Producing a command and successfully executing it are separate events.

blocks.alt: What does calling Word or a Linux command mean?

caption.zh: 天气是流程示例，不显示实时预报。
caption.en: Weather illustrates the flow; no live forecast is shown.

beats.zh: 应用先提供可用工具说明，例如天气工具需要城市和日期。模型才知道怎样提出请求。
beats.en: The app describes available tools, including weather's city and day inputs, so the model can request a call.

beats.zh: 模型生成工具名称和所需信息。代码中的 city 是城市、day 是日期；这些叫调用参数，还不是查到的结果。
beats.en: The model produces a tool name and inputs. In the code city and day specify the request; these arguments are not the weather result.

beats.zh: 外围程序读懂这个请求，实际调用天气服务。发起网络查询的是程序，不是屏幕上的文字自己在执行。
beats.en: The surrounding program reads the request and calls the weather service. Software performs the query described by the generated text.

beats.zh: 服务返回 rain，意思是下雨。程序把结果再送入模型，模型才可以据此继续安排。
beats.en: The service returns rain. The program supplies that result to the model, which can then continue planning.

blocks.text: Sandbox: where do actions happen?

A sandbox is a concrete environment where programs execute and work is stored, such as a project directory or isolated container. Software supplies the directory, tools and executor. Think of a workbench with material, available operations and observable results.

Reading returns source text; writing changes material; search selects relevant passages; a database query returns records matching conditions. To find this week's tasks, search for notes, read their context, query existing tasks and write the result. These operations serve different purposes.
Harness and loops: connect calls into ongoing work

A harness connects model capability to a task. The software prepares input, describes tools, executes calls, returns observations and retains progress. Agent engineering organizes these parts into a goal-directed system: instructions, files, tools, state and an execution environment.

Loop engineering focuses on iteration: when to continue, what feedback to carry forward and when to stop. Writing can follow gather → outline → draft → compare with sources → revise. The draft and task state change; that does not imply retraining the model on each round. The next chapter opens this loop.

blocks.alt: Harness and loops: connect calls into ongoing work

caption.zh: 天气与工具返回均为示例；切换天气结果可查看另一条路径。
caption.en: Illustrative weather and tool results; switch the weather to see another path.

beats.zh: 目标是安排杭州周六半日活动。Agent（智能体）在这里指：模型根据当前信息提出下一步动作，程序执行后再继续。
beats.en: The goal is a Saturday half-day plan in Hangzhou. Here an agent uses a model to propose actions from current information, then continues after software executes them.

beats.zh: Harness 是围绕模型运行的程序。它先查天气，把“下雨”这条新结果放进下一次输入。
beats.en: The harness is the program around the model. It obtains weather and includes the new rain result in the next input.

beats.zh: 模型根据天气提议下一工具：雨天查场馆，晴天查公园。示意分支用于追踪信息流；仅有分支不能判定Agent。
beats.en: A model proposes a tool from weather observations. These illustrative paths expose information flow; branching alone does not establish an agent.

beats.zh: 程序接着查场馆时间或公园路线，再把结果送回。Harness/Agent 工程就是把输入、动作、结果和下一轮组织成可工作的软件。
beats.en: Software checks opening hours or a park route and returns the result. Harness/agent engineering connects inputs, actions, results and subsequent calls.

pages.title: 08 Observation, autonomy and improvement
pages.summary: The model does not automatically see the entire computer. The model receives observations and proposes actions; software executes and returns actual changes.

blocks.text: How does a finite context follow an external environment?

The model does not automatically see the entire computer. It reads messages and observations supplied by software. A closed loop sends in a goal, obtains a proposed action, executes it and returns the observation. Files, command output and application state enter through that route. Perception here means receiving usable observations.

Suppose the goal is to organize a Word meeting document. Initially there is only a filename; reading it provides the text; extracting tasks and saving them produces another observation. Longer work stores progress outside the finite context and selects what to bring back.

blocks.alt: How does a finite context follow an external environment?

caption.zh: 天气与工具返回均为示例；切换天气结果可查看另一条路径。
caption.en: Illustrative weather and tool results; switch the weather to see another path.

beats.en: The goal is a Saturday half-day plan in Hangzhou. Here an agent uses a model to propose actions from current information, then continues after software executes them.

beats.zh: Harness 是围绕模型运行的程序。它先查天气，把“下雨”这条新结果放进下一次输入。
beats.en: The harness is the program around the model. It obtains weather and includes the new rain result in the next input.

beats.zh: 模型根据天气提议下一工具：雨天查场馆，晴天查公园。示意分支用于追踪信息流；仅有分支不能判定Agent。
beats.en: A model proposes a tool from weather observations. These illustrative paths expose information flow; branching alone does not establish an agent.

beats.zh: 程序接着查场馆时间或公园路线，再把结果送回。Harness/Agent 工程就是把输入、动作、结果和下一轮组织成可工作的软件。
beats.en: Software checks opening hours or a park route and returns the result. Harness/agent engineering connects inputs, actions, results and subsequent calls.

blocks.text: Autonomic systems: monitor, manage and optimize

Autonomy is a system-level goal: monitor state, change configuration or actions toward an objective, then observe the effect. A service might detect a queue, change replicas and check waiting time. Monitoring detects; management acts; optimization improves a chosen objective among feasible alternatives.

Many local loops use conventional software. A model-based agent also acts only in its connected environment. Universal, human-free autonomy is a stronger claim and cannot be inferred from a loop diagram. A discussion of its maturity should not erase existing narrower autonomous systems.
Game characters can combine world rules and models

NPC means non-player character. A conventional state machine can chase a visible player and return when too far away. A language-model system can instead supply a character goal, visible events and available actions for a proposed next step. Dialogue and executed game actions remain separate.

If a character says it will fetch a key, game software must update location, inventory and the key's state, then return the observation. World rules still exist. The same proposal → execution → state feedback pattern appears in an office agent editing a document.
Self-improvement: identify what changed

A task loop identifies the situation, plans an action, executes and observes under a goal. It may revise an artifact or plan. Changing prompts, tools or memory organization changes the assistant; updating learned parameters changes the model. Identify the object before evaluating improvement.

RSI means recursive self-improvement: improved capability feeds back into improving the improvement mechanism. For example, a better code-search system helps improve its successor. Repeated calls or a single draft revision do not by themselves establish that feedback.

blocks.alt: Self-improvement: identify what changed

caption.zh: 三类循环可以相互配合。
caption.en: These kinds of improvement can work together.

beats.zh: 改排序代码：当前成果变，模型可以不变。
beats.en: Revise sorting code: change the artifact, not necessarily the model.

beats.zh: 给助手加运行工具：以后的工作方式变。
beats.en: Add an execution tool: change future assistant behavior.

beats.zh: 训练更新参数：模型版本变。循环工程先决定反馈送回哪个对象。
beats.en: Training changes model parameters. Loop engineering locates the object receiving feedback.

pages.title: 09 From written rules to neural networks
pages.summary: To understand LLMs, compare two broader AI approaches. Graphs encode explicit relations; learned systems adjust parameters from examples. They can be combined.

blocks.text: Symbolic rules and connectionist learning

To understand LLMs, compare two broader AI approaches. One explicitly encodes rules and knowledge; another learns input-output relationships in a parameterized network. This is not a simple history in which one entirely replaces the other. Applications often combine rules, retrieval and learned models.

A grammar can encode an explicit sentence structure. A learned system adjusts parameters across examples to handle many language relationships. Rules can be inspected individually; learning generalizes from examples. The absence of if/else is not a definition of intelligence.

blocks.alt: Symbolic rules and connectionist learning

lines.zh: 皇帝 → 别称 → 皇上

beats.zh: 温度高 + 风扇停；→ 检查散热
beats.en: Hot + fan stopped; → inspect cooling

beats.zh: 皇帝 → 别称 → 皇上；显式实体与关系
beats.en: Emperor → alias → sovereign; Explicit entities and links

caption.zh: 同一类问题可以组合规则、检索和学习。
caption.en: Rules, retrieval and learning can be combined.

blocks.text: Knowledge graphs, meaning and expert systems

A knowledge graph explicitly stores entities and relationships, such as emperor → alternative name → sovereign. It supports lookup and rule-based inference. Syntax concerns structure; semantics concerns meaning. Translation also involves context, order and reference, so a synonym link alone does not translate a sentence.

An expert system encodes domain knowledge and inference rules—for example, high temperature plus a stopped fan suggests checking cooling. New situations may need new rules or another model. Human knowledge engineering and learning parameters from examples are different ways of introducing knowledge.
y = ax + b: a small learning example

Let x be distance, y be fare, a be cost per kilometre and b a starting charge. Records (1,5), (2,7), (3,9) disagree with a=1,b=2, which predicts 3,4,5. Parameters a=2,b=3 predict 5,7,9. Learning uses examples to reduce overall error instead of storing one separate answer for every input.

A line has limited expressive power. Curved or conditional relationships require more features or a richer model. Stacking linear transformations alone can remain equivalent to one linear map; neural networks also use nonlinear operations.
What is stored in a network's connections?

A simple neuron multiplies inputs by weights, adds a bias and applies a nonlinearity. With input [2,1], weights [0.5,0.2] and zero bias, the sum is 1.2. ReLU outputs max(0,1.2)=1.2; a negative sum would produce zero. That bend makes it nonlinear.

Layers compose these operations. Training changes weights; inference uses them. A connection represents a computational dependency, not necessarily one stored fact. Explicit graph relations differ from statistical relationships distributed across learned parameters.

blocks.alt: What is stored in a network's connections?

beats.zh: 先固定两个输入和权重。权重控制每个输入怎样影响结果。
beats.en: Fix two inputs and weights; each weight determines an input's contribution.
Add 2×0.5 and 1×0.2 plus zero bias to obtain 1.2.

beats.zh: ReLU 取和与 0 中较大者。把第一个输入改为负数，观察输出怎样改变。
beats.en: ReLU takes the maximum of the sum and zero. Change the first input to a negative value and compare.

caption.zh: 两输入、单神经元的教学算例；真实模型由大量算子组合。
caption.en: A two-input, one-neuron teaching example; real models compose many operations.

pages.title: 10 Multiple agents: split tasks and exchange results
pages.summary: A multi-agent system assigns work to executors with separate task states. Agents coordinate through tasks and results; they are not parameter experts inside MoE.

blocks.text: Multiple agents: separate tasks and contexts, then exchange results

A multi-agent system assigns work to executors with separate task states. They may share a model service or use different models. Explain assignments, available information, handoff format and synthesis. MoE experts inside one model are a different architectural layer.

For a product comparison, agents can investigate price, features and constraints, then a coordinator combines results. Parallelism helps independent work; duplication, dependencies and synthesis add time. More agents do not automatically supply missing evidence or establish self-improvement.

blocks.alt: Multiple agents: separate tasks and contexts, then exchange results

caption.zh: 虚构手机比较：GB 表示存储容量，h 表示小时；多个工作者可使用同一个模型。
caption.en: Fictional phone comparison: GB is storage capacity, h is hours; workers can share the same model.

beats.zh: 协调者把三个产品分开调查，都问容量、价格、续航。
beats.en: The coordinator assigns three product investigations with the same capacity, price and battery questions.

beats.zh: 工作者各有上下文，同一模型可以分别调用三次；不要求三种模型。
beats.en: Workers have separate contexts; one model can serve three calls without requiring three different models.

beats.zh: 摘要交回后才能合成总表。Agent swarm常指这样一组协作智能体。
beats.en: Returned summaries enable synthesis; agent swarm often describes such a collaborating group.

blocks.text: Parallel work saves waiting; integration takes time
After assigning work, count elapsed waiting rather than model names.
Include synthesis in the end-to-end time.

blocks.alt: Parallel work saves waiting; integration takes time

caption.zh: 时间为教学示例。横向长度采用同一时间比例。
caption.en: Illustrative timings; both rows share the same scale.

beats.en: Serial: 4+4+4+2=14 minutes.

beats.zh: 资源允许时同时做：等4分钟再汇总2分钟，共6分钟；工作量仍为14分钟。
beats.en: With sufficient resources, parallel tasks take four minutes plus two for synthesis; effort remains fourteen worker-minutes.

pages.title: 11 Data, parameters and training stages
pages.summary: Training material may include web pages, books and code. Corpora become token sequences. K/M/B/T count parameters; bytes measure storage.

blocks.text: Internet data is not copied character by character into a filing cabinet

Training material may include web pages, books and code. Preparation handles format, duplication and quality before tokenization. “Character by character” is an intuition: the actual units are tokens, and training can calculate losses at many sequence positions together.
Assume the line 离离原上草 is split by character. Given 离离, the next target is 原; given 离离原, it is 上. One passage supplies several learning positions. A real tokenizer may choose a different split.

blocks.alt: Internet data is not copied character by character into a filing cabinet

beats.zh: 文本 → Token 序列；前文 → 真实后续；样本用于调整参数
beats.en: Text → token sequences; Prefix → observed next; Examples update parameters

beats.zh: K = 10³；M = 10⁶；B = 10⁹；T = 10¹²；B 不等于 Byte
beats.en: K = 10³; M = 10⁶; B = 10⁹; T = 10¹²; B does not mean byte

caption.zh: Token 数量、参数数量和存储空间，是不同的量。
caption.en: Token counts, parameter counts and storage are different quantities.

blocks.text: K, M, B and T in parameter counts

Parameters are adjustable values such as weights and biases. K=10³, M=10⁶, B=10⁹ and T=10¹². Thus 35B means 35 billion and 2.8T means 2.8 trillion parameters. B here abbreviates billion; a byte is a storage unit.
A count does not specify bits per value, training data, parameters active per token or task quality. Later sections connect counts to memory and MoE activation.
Pretraining and mid-training: broad exposure, then a focused curriculum

Pretraining learns patterns from broad material through repeated prediction and updates. The reading analogy emphasizes exposure across examples rather than a complete hand-written grammar followed by fact memorization.

Mid-training often means continuing a base model with focused data or objectives, such as specialist material, code or long-context tasks. It is not a universally standardized phase. The close-reading analogy highlights a changed curriculum, not a specific training recipe.

blocks.alt: Pretraining and mid-training: broad exposure, then a focused curriculum

beats.zh: 广泛文本与代码；学习一般模式
beats.en: Broad text and code; Learn broad patterns

beats.zh: 集中材料或目标；例如长上下文、领域
beats.en: Focused data or objectives; E.g. long context or domain

beats.zh: 示范、偏好与奖励；塑造任务行为
beats.en: Examples, preferences, rewards; Shape task behavior

caption.zh: 中训练并非统一必经阶段；RLHF 是后训练方法之一。
caption.en: Mid-training is not a universal required phase; RLHF is one post-training method.

blocks.text: Post-training and RLHF: move from continuation to task behavior

Post-training shapes task behavior in an existing model. SFT supplies demonstrations, while preference data compares possible answers. RLHF—reinforcement learning from human feedback—uses human feedback to form a reward signal for policy training.

Two meeting summaries may differ in whether a deadline is retained and clearly organized. Preference feedback can favor the more useful behavior, while factual correctness remains a separate property. Post-training can also use automatic checks or verifiable rewards; humans need not score every update word by word.
Training develops the model; inference uses it
Save learned a and b to estimate a new journey's fare. Training changes parameters; inference uses learned parameters on the current input.
Learned parameters and current context are different things.

blocks.alt: Training develops the model; inference uses it

caption.zh: 微调指在已有模型上继续训练；贴入文件是提供上下文。
caption.en: Fine-tuning continues training from an existing model; supplying a document provides context.

beats.zh: 训练用许多已知输入和目标的例子，反复预测、比较、调参数。学好的参数保存成一个模型版本。
beats.en: Training repeatedly predicts, compares and adjusts using examples with known targets. Learned parameters are saved as a model version.

beats.zh: 推理就是使用这个版本处理新输入。贴一份新文件后能回答，是因为这次读到了文件，通常没有因此改变参数。
beats.en: Inference uses that version on new input. A supplied document can inform a response because it is in context, usually without changing parameters.

blocks.text: Learning and exams: why hold examples out?

Training updates parameters from examples. Evaluation checks behavior on examples withheld from that training. Testing only on rehearsed answers confuses memorization with transfer. A benchmark is a set of tasks, inputs and scoring rules, not just a leaderboard number.

A model can propose questions or counterexamples, but answers and scoring still need checking, and some tasks should remain unused in tuning. Comparing coding assistants also requires describing tools, time and attempts; otherwise the scores may compare different exam conditions.

blocks.alt: Learning and exams: why hold examples out?

beats.zh: 先定义三个任务及完成条件，不先决定哪个品牌胜出。
beats.en: Define tasks and completion conditions before comparing brands.

beats.zh: 保持任务条件一致，把模型、工具与执行看作一个候选系统。
beats.en: Keep task conditions comparable and treat model, tools and execution as one candidate.

beats.zh: 本例三个任务中完成两个，完成率为 2/3；仍保留未完成的那一项和时间、用量。
beats.en: The teaching example completes two of three tasks. Keep the failed item, time and usage alongside 2/3 completion.

caption.zh: 合成评分样例，不是任何实际产品的评测结果。
caption.en: Synthetic scoring example, not measured product performance.

pages.title: 12 SFT, RL, loss, reward and advantage
pages.summary: Suppose four candidate probabilities are [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1] and the observed continuation 原 is candidate three. Observed next token 原: probability 0.2→0.6, negative log loss 1.609→0.511.

blocks.text: Candidate probabilities and a target are different quantities

Suppose four candidate probabilities are [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1] and the observed continuation 原 is candidate three. A target [0,0,1,0] marks that observation. It is not another model guess. Training computes a loss from this target and updates parameters.

ln denotes the natural logarithm. Negative log probability assigns larger loss to smaller target probabilities; probability one gives zero loss. For this position, negative log probability is −ln(0.2)≈1.609. Raising the target's probability to 0.6 lowers it to about 0.511. The animation adjusts other candidates so probabilities still sum to one. These are teaching values, not measured model outputs.

blocks.alt: Candidate probabilities and a target are different quantities

steps.zh: 目标概率提高，损失降低

beats.zh: 给定前文“离离”，本例真实后续是“原”，为四个候选中的第三项。
beats.en: Given prefix 离离, the observed next item 原 is candidate three.
The prediction is [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1]; target [0,0,1,0] marks the observed item.

beats.zh: 本例把“原”的概率从 0.2 调到 0.6，其负对数损失从 1.609 降到 0.511；总概率一直为 1。
beats.en: The toy update raises 原 from 0.2 to 0.6, lowering negative log loss from 1.609 to 0.511 while probabilities sum to one.

caption.zh: 概率与更新为教学设定，不是模型实测；更新展示目标，不模拟完整梯度训练。
caption.en: Illustrative probabilities and update, not a model measurement or full gradient training.

blocks.text: SFT: learn behavior from demonstrations

SFT is supervised fine-tuning. Training pairs an input with a demonstrated output and increases the probability of that behavior under the input. Meeting text paired with a correct task table teaches the desired fields. A task may have several valid demonstrations, not one unique sentence.

The engineering analogy highlights a relatively explicit target. Training still requires examples, loss computation and parameter updates. Pasting one good answer into a conversation supplies an in-context example; it is not itself SFT.

blocks.alt: SFT: learn behavior from demonstrations

lines.zh: 生成程序 → 运行测试
结果评分 → 学习信号

beats.zh: 输入：会议原文；目标：事项／人／日期；学习示范输出的概率
beats.en: Input: meeting transcript; Target: task / owner / date; Learn demonstrated output

beats.zh: 输入：编程问题；生成程序 → 运行测试；结果评分 → 学习信号
beats.en: Input: coding problem; Generate → execute tests; Outcome score → learning

caption.zh: 两种信号都能用于工程与科学；粘贴范例不等于更新参数。
caption.en: Both signals serve engineering and science; pasting an example is not a parameter update.

blocks.text: RL: learn from outcomes without a demonstrated answer

RL is reinforcement learning. The system tries actions or generates an answer, receives an outcome score and learns to favor more successful behavior. For a programming task, tests can score a generated program without first supplying the complete solution. A percentage is one possible scoring scheme, not the definition of RL.

The science analogy emphasizes exploration with observable outcomes rather than a complete prescribed solution. SFT is not restricted to engineering, nor RL to science; practical systems can combine both kinds of signal.
What do loss, reward and advantage compare?

Loss is a numerical objective minimized during optimization. Next-token training can use negative log probability of the actual continuation. Reward evaluates an outcome and is generally maximized. A lower arbitrary score does not automatically mean better task performance.

Advantage compares an outcome with a baseline. In a toy group with rewards 1 and 0, mean 0.5 gives advantages +0.5 and −0.5. A policy update can favor relatively better behavior, with further terms in real algorithms. The group mean is one illustrative baseline, not the universal RL definition.

blocks.alt: What do loss, reward and advantage compare?

steps.zh: 用相对表现影响策略更新

beats.zh: 任务要求保留截止日期。先看两个回答到底保留了什么。
beats.en: The task requires a deadline. Compare what each answer retained.

beats.zh: 本例保留日期得 1 分，遗漏日期得 0 分；这是明确规定的教学评分。
beats.en: This toy rubric awards 1 for retaining the date and 0 for omitting it.
With mean reward 0.5 as baseline, advantages are +0.5 and −0.5.

beats.zh: 正优势提供鼓励该行为的学习信号，负优势提供相反信号；真正算法还包含其他项。
beats.en: Positive advantage supports favoring the behavior; negative advantage provides the opposite signal. Real algorithms add further terms.

caption.zh: 组均值基线是教学例子；奖励、优势与优化损失不是同一个数。
caption.en: A group-mean baseline illustrates the idea; reward, advantage and loss are distinct.

pages.title: 13 Scaling laws: data, parameters and inference compute
pages.summary: Scaling laws describe empirical relationships between prediction loss, model size, training data and compute under comparable experimental conditions. Under fixed compute, allocate model scale N and data D together; bigger requires conditions.

blocks.text: Scaling laws: distinguish three kinds of growth

Scaling laws describe empirical relationships between prediction loss, model size, training data and compute under comparable experimental conditions. “Bigger” has several dimensions: parameters, training tokens and computation. Maximizing one alone is not a universal optimum.

At fixed compute, a larger model costs more per token and may see less data. The diagram holds N×D constant and varies model scale N against data D. Its explicitly labeled toy loss demonstrates allocation; it does not predict the capability of a real model.

blocks.alt: Scaling laws: distinguish three kinds of growth

steps.zh: 固定 N×D 的示意预算
增大 N，也要减少 D
比较同预算下的玩具损失
steps.en: Compare toy losses at equal budget

beats.zh: N 表示相对模型规模，D 表示相对训练数据量；本图固定 N×D=16。
beats.en: N is relative model scale and D relative data; this example fixes N×D=16.

beats.zh: 选择不同 N，观察 D=16/N 同步变化。模型更大不是免费增加计算。
beats.en: Change N and observe D=16/N. Larger models are not a free compute increase.

beats.zh: 玩具损失 N^−0.5+D^−0.5 在本例均衡分配时更低。真实最优点需要实际训练实验。
beats.en: Toy loss N^−0.5+D^−0.5 is lower at a balanced allocation here. Real optima require training experiments.

caption.zh: 无量纲玩具函数，只说明预算分配，不用于预测真实模型质量。
caption.en: Dimensionless toy function for allocation, not a predictor of real model quality.

blocks.text: More inference work belongs to the current task

A trained model can spend more computation on one task: longer intermediate work, several candidates, retrieval or execution and checking. This is inference expenditure and usually does not update parameters. Training scale and inference scale are different axes.

For arithmetic, one response may answer directly; another writes and runs a calculator, checks it and answers. Extra steps help only when they add useful work. Compare the same problems with an explicit score and latency; longer waiting is not itself stronger reasoning.

blocks.alt: More inference work belongs to the current task

beats.zh: 问题：17 × 23；教学候选：381；尚未计算核对
beats.en: Question: 17 × 23; Toy proposal: 381; No calculation check yet

beats.zh: 计算器：17 × 23；得到 391；核对后修正为 391
beats.en: Calculator: 17 × 23; Result: 391; Revise the answer to 391

caption.zh: 教学候选不是产品实测；新增步骤提供有效反馈才可能帮助任务。
caption.en: The proposal is synthetic, not measured. Extra work helps when it supplies useful feedback.

blocks.text: Translate the “brain capacity” analogy into memory

Brain capacity is only an analogy, not a conversion from parameter count to human intelligence. A concrete question is count times bits per value. Kimi K3's technical report lists 2.8T total and 104B active parameters. Storing 2.8T values at 16 bits would require about 5.6 TB for raw weights.

That is weights alone. Inference also needs context caches and working memory; training adds gradients and optimizer state. Compression and mixed precision mean file size, theoretical weight size and device usage are different quantities.

blocks.alt: Translate the “brain capacity” analogy into memory

beats.en: 2.8 T; 2.8 × 10¹² values

beats.zh: 16 bit = 2 Byte；统一精度粗算
beats.en: 16 bit = 2 bytes; Uniform-precision estimate

caption.zh: 十进制单位；未包含缓存、工作区、梯度或优化器。
caption.en: Decimal units; excludes caches, workspace, gradients and optimizer state.

items.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models

pages.title: 14 Chips, precision and quantization
pages.summary: GPUs perform similar operations in parallel, but performance depends on arithmetic, memory capacity, data movement and communication. Capacity stores, bandwidth moves data and compute units perform arithmetic.

blocks.text: Chips and compute: fit, calculate and communicate

GPUs perform similar operations in parallel, but performance depends on arithmetic, memory capacity, data movement and communication. Capacity is workspace; bandwidth moves data; compute performs operations. One figure cannot replace all three.

Thousands-of-chips or hundred-thousand-card examples illustrate possible system scale, not a minimum for every model. Small models can run on one device; large training may use clusters. More cards also introduce communication and coordination cost; speed must be measured from completed work.

blocks.alt: Chips and compute: fit, calculate and communicate

caption.zh: 三个概念分别对应容量、带宽、计算能力。
caption.en: Capacity, bandwidth and compute describe different aspects.

beats.zh: GPU 是擅长大量相似运算的处理器。显存是它旁边用来存数字的空间，放模型参数和运行数据；容量常用 GB 表示。
beats.en: A GPU is a processor suited to many similar operations. Device memory holds parameters and working data; capacity is commonly measured in GB.

beats.zh: 计算单元要先拿到数字。带宽是每秒能搬多少数据，常用 GB/s；空间大与搬得快是两个指标。
beats.en: Compute units must receive the numbers. Bandwidth measures data moved per second, often GB/s; capacity and movement rate are different.

beats.zh: 输入[2,3]、[1,4]都与参数[5,4]逐项相乘相加，独立得到22、21。GPU并行做许多这类计算。
beats.en: Inputs [2,3] and [1,4] use shared parameters [5,4] to produce independent sums 22 and 21; GPUs parallelize many such operations.

blocks.text: Convert FP16, FP8 and 4-bit values into storage

Eight bits equal one byte. FP16 uses two bytes per value; FP8 uses one; tightly packed 4-bit values allow two per byte. FP denotes floating point. INT4 and FP4 both use four bits but have different numerical encodings.

For 35B weights, decimal raw sizes are about 70 GB, 35 GB and 17.5 GB. Quantized files may also contain scales, grouping metadata and higher-precision components. Runtime memory adds caches and workspace.
Quantization: what changes when representation shrinks?

Quantization maps fine-grained values onto a finite set. With toy step 0.25, [1.23,−0.78,0.41] becomes integer codes [5,−3,2] and reconstructs to [1.25,−0.75,0.50]. Errors are +0.02,+0.03,+0.09. Real methods can use group-specific scales; this example exposes the mapping.

Shorter decimals illustrate coarser representation, but quantization is not simply trimming a fixed number of decimal places. It reduces storage and movement; speed depends on hardware and kernels, while quality must be checked on tasks. Half the bits does not guarantee twice the speed with unchanged answers.

blocks.alt: Quantization: what changes when representation shrinks?

steps.zh: 除步长、取整并限制编码范围

beats.zh: 先读三个原始权重。存储位数减少后，可表示的档位也会减少。
beats.en: Read three original weights. Fewer bits provide fewer representable levels.

beats.zh: 本例用有符号 4 位整数 −8…7 编码。除以步长、四舍五入，再限制到这个范围。
beats.en: This example uses signed 4-bit integer codes −8…7: divide by the step, round and clip to range.

beats.zh: 整数码乘回步长得到近似值。改变步长，比较舍入误差与超范围截断；实际量化还可按组设计。
beats.en: Multiply codes by the step to reconstruct approximations. Change the step to compare rounding and clipping; real quantizers can work by groups.

caption.zh: 教学均匀量化器；不是所有 FP8、FP4 或实际模型的量化方法。
caption.en: A toy uniform quantizer, not the definition of every FP8/FP4 format or model quantizer.

pages.title: 15 GPU links, clusters and inference engines
pages.summary: When a model spans GPUs, each stores and computes a portion. An engine implements sharding and communication; links alone do not create one transparent memory pool.

blocks.text: NVLink and multi-GPU links: what travels?

When a model spans GPUs, each stores and computes a portion. Devices exchange intermediate values and sometimes combine partial results; training also exchanges gradients. NVLink is one GPU interconnect technology, while crossing machines involves the cluster network.

Four linked 24 GB cards do not automatically become one transparent 96 GB device for every program. The engine must shard and communicate using supported hardware. The diagram first places weight shards, then moves intermediate results and combines output: wires alone do not perform that work.

blocks.alt: NVLink and multi-GPU links: what travels?

steps.zh: 一次计算跨卡传中间结果

beats.zh: 同一模型的权重分在四张卡上。图中的每张卡只保存一份分片。
beats.en: One model is split over four cards, each holding a weight shard.

beats.zh: 设备之间需要数据通路。NVLink 是 GPU 互联技术之一；跨机器另有网络。
beats.en: Devices need paths for data. NVLink is one GPU interconnect; inter-node networking is another layer.

beats.zh: 一份请求经过各自负责的计算，中间状态沿连线传递，再得到结果。分片与通信要由引擎实现。
beats.en: A request passes through the assigned computation, exchanging intermediate states before output. Engines implement sharding and communication.

caption.zh: 示意流水式模型分片；真实张量、流水与专家并行的通信模式不同。
caption.en: Illustrative pipeline sharding; tensor, pipeline and expert parallelism communicate differently.

blocks.text: Kubernetes places services; engines execute models

Organize devices into services. A node is a machine in a managed cluster; Kubernetes places a service, while its inference engine performs model execution. Placement is not repeated per token. Earlier positions do not attend to later generated tokens, so their attention states can be retained. Generating E still reads cached A/B/C states and computes the new D state. A cache avoids recomputation without discarding context.
A cluster organizes machines; an engine executes a model.

blocks.alt: Kubernetes places services; engines execute models

detail.zh: 安排实例在哪台节点运行

caption.zh: Prefill = 先处理输入；Decode = 逐步生成。KV 缓存保存注意力中的键/值数值，供后续复用。
caption.en: Prefill processes input; decode generates step by step. A KV cache retains attention key/value states for reuse.

beats.zh: 集群是联网管理的一组机器；其中一台叫节点。Kubernetes，简称 K8s，是安排程序在哪台机器运行的软件。
beats.en: A cluster is a managed group of networked machines; each machine is a node. Kubernetes, or K8s, places programs on those machines.

pages.title: 16 Measuring latency and throughput
pages.summary: Latency is time for a request: distinguish the first visible output from full completion. End-to-end latency = first-token wait + generation after the first token.

blocks.text: Put one response on a timeline

Take one user's perspective: how long after sending? Time to first token and time to finish capture different experiences. The initial 0.8 seconds can include network, queueing and input processing, not just model computation. Two further seconds give 2.8 seconds total. Fast first output and fast completion are different; identify timing boundaries before comparing speed.
End-to-end latency = first-token wait + generation after the first token.

blocks.alt: Put one response on a timeline

caption.zh: 教学时间线；点只表示到达过程，不逐个对应全部 Token。
caption.en: Illustrative timeline; dots depict arrivals rather than every token.

beats.zh: 延迟就是一次请求要等多久。从点击发送开始计时，直到回答全部结束，是端到端延迟。
beats.en: Latency measures how long a request takes. End-to-end latency runs from sending it to the completed response.

beats.en: The first token arrives at 0.8 seconds. Time to first token, TTFT, includes network, queueing and input processing.

beats.zh: 第一个之后还生成 2 秒，文字逐步到达。这段是后续生成时间，和首个之前的等待分开看。
beats.en: More tokens arrive over the next two seconds. This is subsequent generation time, separate from the wait for the first token.

beats.en: The response ends at 2.8 seconds: 0.8 seconds to the first token plus two seconds of further generation.

blocks.text: Same requests, different batching

Move from one user's output to four requests totaling ten tokens. Two slots each advance one token per active request per round. By round three A has finished: a fixed batch waits for B, while continuous batching inserts C. Total work finishes earlier, yet B still finishes in round four under both policies. Aggregate throughput and individual latency are different measures.
Aggregate throughput = total output tokens divided by elapsed time.

beats.en: Throughput measures total work per second, here output tokens. Four requests need 2, 4, 1, 3 tokens, ten in total. Two slots advance at most two requests per round.

beats.zh: 每格 A1 表示 A 的第一个 Token。第 3 轮 A 已结束：固定批次空等 B，连续批处理把 C 放进空位；下方一轮一轮比较。
beats.en: Cell A1 is A's first token. By round three A has finished: fixed batches wait for B, while continuous batching puts C in the free slot. Compare round by round.

beats.en: Ten tokens finish in seven versus six rounds, but B finishes at round four under both: aggregate throughput and individual latency differ.

pages.title: 18 Model choice: ecosystem, task and MoE
pages.summary: An ecosystem includes tokenizers, chat templates, inference engines, clients, tool-call formats, examples and maintenance. Start from the task, then compare toolchains, capacity, concurrency, consistency and outcomes.

blocks.text: What makes an ecosystem useful?

An ecosystem includes tokenizers, chat templates, inference engines, clients, tool-call formats, examples and maintenance. Weights without suitable engine support may be difficult to run efficiently; unsupported tool formats prevent proposed actions from being executed correctly.

Compare a complete small task: read a document, answer a checkable question and use one actual tool. That tests the model-toolchain combination rather than whether a chat page opens. Ecosystem fit improves usability but does not guarantee answer quality.
Fit the deployment, then compare the task

Estimate weights, caches and working space for the intended context and concurrency. Fitting weights is only the start: long inputs and simultaneous requests grow cache use, and slow execution increases waiting. An API moves operation to a provider, while service latency, quotas and usage cost still matter.

The largest runnable model is a candidate, not automatically the winner. If a smaller model reliably extracts the required fields while a larger one is much slower, compare quality against resources. Keep device and task conditions comparable.
Task fit: start with your work, then consult benchmarks

Use representative inputs and define completion. Meeting notes can be checked for correct tasks, owners and dates; code can run tests; images need subject, composition and text criteria. Families such as DeepSeek and Qwen are candidates, not scores.

Automatic grading suits precisely checkable outcomes; open writing and visual quality need explicit human criteria. Public benchmarks provide context, while local tasks test your fit. Record checkpoint, prompt, tools, input length and attempts rather than combining incomparable scores.

A useful comparison records task completion, fields or tests, first-output wait, total time, usage and failure categories. These are measurement fields; the course does not fill them with invented product results.

blocks.text: MoE: a token uses selected expert modules

MoE means Mixture of Experts. Experts are internal computation modules, not independent chatbots. A router selects some modules for a token representation and combines their results; another token may take another route. Shared attention and other computation still exist.

Total parameters count the model's adjustable values; active parameters describe the subset used for a token. A large model with sparse activation is therefore possible. Unselected experts remain part of the model and may be needed for later tokens.

blocks.text: Read Qwen3.6-35B-A3B correctly

In the official Qwen3.6-35B-A3B example, 35B denotes about 35 billion total parameters and A3B about 3 billion active parameters. A indicates activation, not a 3B-sized checkpoint. Routing saves some computation while storage still depends on full weights or an actual sharding/offloading scheme.

At a uniform 16 bits, raw weights are roughly 35×10⁹×2≈70 GB. Using 3B×2=6 GB as the whole model's requirement is incorrect. Released precision, extra modules, caches and engine implementation also matter.

Image understanding produces an interpretation of an image; image generation creates one; video generation is another output task. A company may offer several families, so the board's MiniMax/image and DeepSeek/text examples do not replace a checkpoint's actual input-output specification.

Here Codex CLI illustrates coding-agent software, while GPT and Opus name different model families. The harness organizes project work, tools and iteration; the model generates responses or action proposals. A harness–model pair is a comparison unit, not a claim that every product accepts every model interchangeably.

Holding the harness fixed while changing the model tests different generation and action behavior. Holding the model fixed while changing the harness tests context and execution organization. If both change, an improvement cannot be attributed solely to the model.

blocks.text: Why does model–harness coordination matter?

Training and evaluation can familiarize a model with particular tool descriptions, return formats and workflows. A harness also designs templates, adapters and state handling around model behavior. Coordination can matter more than changing a model name alone.

A model may propose open_document(file) while the available tool is read_file(path). Similar intent does not make the calls identical to software. An adapter must connect arguments and results before the observation can feed the next round.
Read the Kimi Code, K2.5 and DeepSeek harness examples

The Kimi Code → K2.5 and DeepSeek harness examples place models back into their working toolchains. K2.5 is a checkpoint; Kimi Code is an agent product. A product's serving model can change. Its current site advertises other versions, so K2.5 remains a concrete historical example rather than a permanent product specification.

To read a harness, locate its inputs, tools, result handling, retained progress and continuation rule. DeepSeek may name a model or appear in an application's configuration. A brand name alone does not specify the complete system behavior.
Harnesses differ in how much work they organize

A thin wrapper may send text and display a response. A fuller harness selects files, runs tools, retains state and organizes longer work across contexts. Thickness describes responsibility, not quality: some tasks need one call, while others require files and feedback.

For meeting notes, one wrapper returns a summary; a fuller workflow reads a transcript, checks names, extracts tasks, writes them through a tool and presents the result. Each added step should contribute observable work, rather than merely adding agent labels.

title.zh: 一条短片，可以由多个模型接力完成
title.en: Several models can contribute to one short film

takeaway.zh: 单张图只是创作中的一环。
takeaway.en: A single image is one part of making a fifteen-second film.

concepts: 多模态生成提供材料，工作流把材料变成作品。
Multimodal generation supplies material; workflow forms the artifact.

title.zh: 提示词：把“写文章”拆成可执行的要求
title.en: Prompts: turn “write an article” into explicit conditions

takeaway.zh: 提示词是本次发给模型的任务说明。
takeaway.en: A prompt states the task for the current call.

title.zh: 上下文：要求之外，还需要哪些信息？
title.en: Context: what information accompanies the instruction?

takeaway.zh: 上下文是这一次实际送入模型的内容：指令、相关对话、原始通知、检索片段、工具结果等。
takeaway.en: Context is what a call actually receives: instructions, relevant dialogue, the notice, retrieved passages and tool results.

title.zh: RAG：先找资料，再带着资料回答

takeaway.zh: 公司制度可能有几百页，但这个问题只问报销期限。
takeaway.en: A policy collection may span hundreds of pages while the question asks only for an expense deadline.

concepts: 检索找材料，模型带着材料生成回答。
Retrieval finds material; generation answers with it.

title.zh: 调用 Word、电脑指令与 Linux，是什么意思？
title.en: What does calling Word or a Linux command mean?

takeaway.zh: 模型输出“把标题改成会议纪要”只是文字。
takeaway.en: The text “change the title” does not edit a file.

takeaway.zh: Sandbox 是程序执行和保存工作状态的具体环境，例如一个工作目录或隔离容器。
takeaway.en: A sandbox is a concrete environment where programs execute and work is stored, such as a project directory or isolated container.

title.zh: Harness 与 Loop：把一次生成接成连续工作
title.en: Harness and loops: connect calls into ongoing work

takeaway.zh: Harness 原意是把力量接到任务上的一套装置；在这里指围绕模型的软件：准备输入，描述工具，执行调用，把结果送回，并保存任务进展。
takeaway.en: A harness connects model capability to a task.

title.zh: 有限上下文，怎样跟上外部环境？
title.en: How does a finite context follow an external environment?

takeaway.zh: 模型不会自动看到整台电脑。
takeaway.en: The model does not automatically see the entire computer.

title.zh: 自治系统：监测、管理与优化
title.en: Autonomic systems: monitor, manage and optimize

takeaway.zh: 自治是一个系统层面的目标：监测自身状态，根据目标调整配置或动作，再观察效果。
takeaway.en: Autonomy is a system-level goal: monitor state, change configuration or actions toward an objective, then observe the effect.

title.zh: 游戏角色：有规则的世界也可以接模型
title.en: Game characters can combine world rules and models

takeaway.zh: 游戏里的非玩家角色通常称 NPC，non-player character。
takeaway.en: NPC means non-player character.

title.zh: 自进化：先看究竟改了什么

takeaway.zh: 一次任务循环包含目标、识别现状、制定下一步、执行和观察。
takeaway.en: A task loop identifies the situation, plans an action, executes and observes under a goal.

title.zh: 规则路线与连接学习路线

takeaway.zh: LLM 是大语言模型，但理解它可以先看更广的 AI 两条路线：一条由人明确写规则和知识；另一条用带参数的计算网络，从样本中学习输入到输出的关系。
takeaway.en: To understand LLMs, compare two broader AI approaches.

title.zh: 知识图谱、语义与专家系统
title.en: Knowledge graphs, meaning and expert systems

takeaway.zh: 知识图谱把实体和关系显式保存成节点与连线，例如“皇帝—别称—皇上”。
takeaway.en: A knowledge graph explicitly stores entities and relationships, such as emperor → alternative name → sovereign.

title.zh: y = ax + b：最小的学习例子
title.en: y = ax + b: a small learning example

takeaway.zh: 设 x 是路程，y 是费用，a 是每公里费用，b 是起步费。
takeaway.en: Let x be distance, y be fare, a be cost per kilometre and b a starting charge.

title.en: What is stored in a network's connections?

takeaway.zh: 一个简化神经元先把输入乘权重，再加偏置，最后做非线性变换。
takeaway.en: A simple neuron multiplies inputs by weights, adds a bias and applies a nonlinearity.

title.zh: 多 Agent：分开任务与上下文，再交换结果
title.en: Multiple agents: separate tasks and contexts, then exchange results

takeaway.zh: 多 Agent 系统把工作分给多个有各自任务状态的执行者。
takeaway.en: A multi-agent system assigns work to executors with separate task states.

title.zh: 并行节省等待，整合仍需要时间
title.en: Parallel work saves waiting; integration takes time

takeaway.zh: 分工之后只算等待多久，先不讨论模型名字。
takeaway.en: After assigning work, count elapsed waiting rather than model names..

concepts: 并行重叠独立工作，整合仍要时间。
Parallel work overlaps independent tasks; synthesis still takes time.

title.zh: 互联网数据，不是逐字抄进一个资料柜
title.en: Internet data is not copied character by character into a filing cabinet

takeaway.zh: 训练语料可以包含网页、书籍、代码等材料。
takeaway.en: Training material may include web pages, books and code.

title.en: K, M, B and T in parameter counts

takeaway.zh: 参数是训练中可以调整的数，例如权重和偏置。
takeaway.en: Parameters are adjustable values such as weights and biases.

title.zh: 预训练与中训练：广泛阅读，再集中学习
title.en: Pretraining and mid-training: broad exposure, then a focused curriculum

takeaway.zh: 预训练用较广泛的数据学习语言、代码和其他规律。
takeaway.en: Pretraining learns patterns from broad material through repeated prediction and updates.

title.zh: 后训练与 RLHF：把会续写接到会完成任务
title.en: Post-training and RLHF: move from continuation to task behavior

takeaway.zh: 后训练在已有模型上塑造任务行为。
takeaway.en: Post-training shapes task behavior in an existing model.

title.zh: 训练改本领，推理用本领
title.en: Training develops the model; inference uses it

takeaway.zh: 把学好的 a、b 保存，就能估算新路程的费用。
takeaway.en: Save learned a and b to estimate a new journey's fare.

concepts: 换输入和改参数是两种不同变化。
Changing input and changing parameters are different.

title.zh: 学习与考试：为什么要把题目留出来？
title.en: Learning and exams: why hold examples out?

takeaway.zh: 训练会用样本更新参数；测试用于观察学过以后能否处理未用于这次训练的例子。
takeaway.en: Training updates parameters from examples.

title.zh: 候选概率与正确目标，不是同一列数
title.en: Candidate probabilities and a target are different quantities

takeaway.zh: 假设四个候选的预测概率是 [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1]，总和为 1，而真实后续落在第三项“原”。
takeaway.en: Suppose four candidate probabilities are [0.6,0.1,0.2,0.1] and the observed continuation 原 is candidate three.

title.zh: SFT：从示范答案学习怎么做

takeaway.zh: SFT 是 supervised fine-tuning，监督微调。
takeaway.en: SFT is supervised fine-tuning.

title.zh: RL：答案未知，也能用结果反馈学习
title.en: RL: learn from outcomes without a demonstrated answer

takeaway.zh: RL 是 reinforcement learning，强化学习。
takeaway.en: RL is reinforcement learning.

title.en: What do loss, reward and advantage compare?

takeaway.zh: Loss 是优化时要降低的数值目标。
takeaway.en: Loss is a numerical objective minimized during optimization.

title.zh: Scaling Law：三种“变大”不能混在一起
title.en: Scaling laws: distinguish three kinds of growth

takeaway.zh: Scaling Law 是对一组训练实验观察到的规律：在相近任务、数据与训练方法下，模型规模、训练数据和计算预算与预测损失之间常呈现可拟合关系。
takeaway.en: Scaling laws describe empirical relationships between prediction loss, model size, training data and compute under comparable experimental conditions.

title.zh: 推理时多想：增加的是本次任务的计算
title.en: More inference work belongs to the current task

takeaway.zh: 模型训练好以后，仍可在一个问题上投入更多计算：生成更长的中间过程、提出多个候选、搜索资料、运行代码再检查。
takeaway.en: A trained model can spend more computation on one task: longer intermediate work, several candidates, retrieval or execution and checking.

title.zh: “脑容量”这个比喻，怎样换成内存数字？
title.en: Translate the “brain capacity” analogy into memory

takeaway.zh: “脑容量”只能帮助想象可调整数很多，不能把参数个数换算成人的智力。
takeaway.en: Brain capacity is only an analogy, not a conversion from parameter count to human intelligence.

title.zh: 芯片与算力：存得下，还要算得动、传得快
title.en: Chips and compute: fit, calculate and communicate

takeaway.zh: GPU 可并行处理大量相似运算，但性能取决于多件事：计算单元做乘加的速度，显存能存多少，数据怎样从显存搬到计算单元，以及多卡怎样交换数据。
takeaway.en: GPUs perform similar operations in parallel, but performance depends on arithmetic, memory capacity, data movement and communication.

title.zh: FP16、FP8 与 4 bit，怎样换成空间？
title.en: Convert FP16, FP8 and 4-bit values into storage

takeaway.zh: 8 bit 等于 1 Byte。
takeaway.en: Eight bits equal one byte.

title.zh: 量化：省空间时，数值发生了什么？
title.en: Quantization: what changes when representation shrinks?

takeaway.zh: 量化把原来较精细的数映射到有限档位。
takeaway.en: Quantization maps fine-grained values onto a finite set.

title.zh: NVLink 与多卡连线：传的是哪些数据？
title.en: NVLink and multi-GPU links: what travels?

takeaway.zh: 当一份模型分在多张卡上，每张卡存一部分权重，并计算自己负责的部分。
takeaway.en: When a model spans GPUs, each stores and computes a portion.

title.zh: Kubernetes 放置服务，引擎运行模型
title.en: Kubernetes places services; engines execute models

takeaway.zh: 现在把能存会算的设备组织成服务。
takeaway.en: Organize devices into services.

concepts: K8s放服务；引擎读取缓存、计算新位置并生成。
Kubernetes places services; engines read caches and compute new positions.

title.zh: 一次回答的时间，画在同一条线上
title.en: Put one response on a timeline

takeaway.zh: 现在换成一个用户的视角：我点发送，要等多久？先等到首个Token，再等后续内容到齐，这是两种不同体验。
takeaway.en: Take one user's perspective: how long after sending? Time to first token and time to finish capture different experiences.

concepts: 先区分首字等待与全部完成，再说延迟。
Distinguish first-token waiting from full completion.

title.zh: 同样的请求，怎样组织批次？

takeaway.zh: 上一页只数一人的输出，现在把四名用户合起来。
takeaway.en: Move from one user's output to four requests totaling ten tokens.

concepts: 连续批处理减少空等；总吞吐与个人等待分开统计。
Continuous batching reduces idle work; throughput and individual wait remain distinct.

title.zh: 把单卡视角，拉到整个机房
title.en: Widen the view from a chip to a facility

takeaway.zh: 引擎组织一批请求，机房让这种计算能持续运行。
takeaway.en: Engines organize requests; facilities support continuous execution.

concepts: Token工厂指持续提供模型计算的整个系统。
A token factory describes the whole sustained serving system.

takeaway.zh: 生态指让模型被实际使用的一整套支持：分词器、对话模板、推理引擎、客户端、工具调用格式、示例和维护。
takeaway.en: An ecosystem includes tokenizers, chat templates, inference engines, clients, tool-call formats, examples and maintenance.

title.zh: 选能装下的模型，再比较任务表现
title.en: Fit the deployment, then compare the task

takeaway.zh: 先计算权重、缓存和工作空间，再考虑实际上下文长度与同时请求数。
takeaway.en: Estimate weights, caches and working space for the intended context and concurrency.

title.zh: 业务匹配：先有自己的任务，再看榜单
title.en: Task fit: start with your work, then consult benchmarks

takeaway.zh: 选一组真实输入并写清什么算完成。
takeaway.en: Use representative inputs and define completion.

title.zh: MoE：每个 Token 只走部分专家
title.en: MoE: a token uses selected expert modules

takeaway.zh: MoE 是 Mixture of Experts，混合专家。
takeaway.en: MoE means Mixture of Experts.

takeaway.zh: 以官方 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 为例，名称中的 35B 表示约 350 亿总参数，A3B 表示约 30 亿激活参数。
takeaway.en: In the official Qwen3.6-35B-A3B example, 35B denotes about 35 billion total parameters and A3B about 3 billion active parameters.

title.zh: 图像、文字与视频，先看输入输出模态
title.en: Images, text and video: identify the modalities first

takeaway.zh: 看懂图片并输出文字，叫图像理解；从文字生成图片，叫图像生成；生成视频又是另一种输出任务。
takeaway.en: Image understanding produces an interpretation of an image; image generation creates one; video generation is another output task.

title.zh: Codex 与 GPT／Opus：框架名和模型名分开读
title.en: Codex and GPT/Opus: separate the harness name from the model name

takeaway.zh: 这里把 Codex CLI 当作编程 Agent 软件的例子，GPT 和 Opus 是不同模型家族的名称。
takeaway.en: Here Codex CLI illustrates coding-agent software, while GPT and Opus name different model families.

title.zh: 为什么模型与框架会越来越需要配合？

takeaway.zh: 训练和评测可能让模型习惯某种工具描述、返回格式、工作流程和上下文组织。
takeaway.en: Training and evaluation can familiarize a model with particular tool descriptions, return formats and workflows.

title.zh: Kimi Code、K2.5 与 DeepSeek harness 的例子
title.en: Read the Kimi Code, K2.5 and DeepSeek harness examples

takeaway.zh: 用“Kimi Code→K2.5”和“DeepSeek harness”这两个例子看系统配合：要把一个模型放回它使用的编程工具链与环境中看。
takeaway.en: The Kimi Code → K2.5 and DeepSeek harness examples place models back into their working toolchains.

title.zh: “壳的厚度”不同，工作组织也不同
title.en: Harnesses differ in how much work they organize

takeaway.zh: 薄封装可能只是把文字送到模型并显示回答。
takeaway.en: A thin wrapper may send text and display a response.

title.zh: 比较整对组合，怎样避免混淆原因？
title.en: Compare the pair without confusing the cause

takeaway.zh: 选一个明确任务，例如把价格排序程序的错误改掉，运行已有测试并说明修改。
takeaway.en: Use a specific task, such as fixing a price-sort bug, running tests and explaining the edit.

title.zh: 把一句要求，变成可运行的代码
title.en: Turn a request into runnable code

takeaway.zh: 排序本身不需要AI；这里看人提要求、模型写程序、普通计算机执行的分工。
takeaway.en: Sorting itself needs no AI; distinguish the request, generated program and ordinary execution..

concepts: AI编程连接人的目标与可执行程序。
AI coding connects a human goal with an executable program.

title.zh: 从氨基酸序列，预测蛋白质结构
title.en: From amino-acid sequence to protein structure

takeaway.zh: AI不一定输出文章或图片。
takeaway.en: AI can predict scientific objects rather than prose.

concepts: AI4S把学习到的关系用于科学预测。
AI for Science applies learned relationships to scientific prediction.

title.zh: 能力变了，工作习惯怎样跟着变？
title.en: How should work habits respond to changing capability?

takeaway.zh: 如果一直只把 AI 当作续写框，就可能忽略它已经能接工具、执行和整理交付物；反过来，如果把一次成功演示当成普遍能力，也会把不合适的工作交出去。
takeaway.en: Treating AI only as autocomplete can miss tool use and complete artifacts; treating one successful demo as universal capability overstates it.

title.en: How should we read different model families?

takeaway.zh: 先区分公司、模型家族、具体版本与应用。
takeaway.en: Separate a company, family, checkpoint and application.

title.zh: 这与平台的集群管理怎样接起来？
title.en: How does this connect to cluster management?

takeaway.zh: 芯片执行计算，互联搬运数据，推理引擎加载模型并组织生成，集群软件放置服务。
takeaway.en: Chips calculate, links move data, inference engines load models and generate, and cluster software places services.

pages.title: Register and make your first trial call
pages.summary: Register, choose an available model, create an API key and send your first request from a client or terminal.

items.title: Register or sign in
items.text: Register or sign in with an email address or mainland China mobile number and a password of at least six characters. Use the same contact for later sign-ins. Phone registration does not verify SMS ownership; complete any additional checks the page requires.

items.title: Choose a model
items.text: Open MaaS and check the available models, expiry and usage allowance.

items.title: Create and copy a key
items.text: Choose Create trial API key. While it is active, use the eye or copy icon in Account & API keys to retrieve it again.

items.title: Make your first call
items.text: Select Copy first-call example, set API_KEY locally and use the API URL and model ID shown in the portal.

blocks.title: Trial is not a machine rental
blocks.text: It does not include bare-machine access or automatically open hosted ComfyUI. Continuing through an organization invitation replaces trial authority; paid machines retain their separate order and agreement checks.

For a first browser-only attempt, an active trial offers Try a prompt in the workbench. It opens the same-origin workbench using your signed-in trial session: connect, select an allowed model and send a request. It creates no API key and still enforces expiry, model scope and quota. If a request fails, search the exact public code on error-reference. HTTP 401, 403 and 429 each have multiple causes; the public code and current scope determine the next action.

blocks.title: Trial expiry
blocks.text: An expired trial does not renew itself: waiting for expiry does not create another trial. Contact your administrator for continued access.

pages.title: Your first day in the enterprise portal
pages.summary: Choose the right organization and delivery path, review granted resources, and start API or workspace work without copying internal identifiers or assuming that registration grants infrastructure access.
pages.audience: Company owner, invited colleague or private-cloud user

items.title: Choose your organization
items.text: After sign-in, create an Individual or Company customer record, or accept an invitation. Select the intended organization before working; a customer record is not a resource grant. The operator console and customer portal keep separate role checks. On this platform, the portal and approved same-origin business applications share the signed-in session across HTTPS 443 and 8443.

items.title: Choose your delivery path
items.text: Private cloud: an administrator grants workspace resources without a machine-rental contract. Public trial: use the bounded shared-model allowance. Commercial machine: select an offer, accept required terms, complete checkout and wait for confirmed provisioning.

items.title: Use the granted resource
items.text: For MaaS, create a scoped API key and use Copy first-call example in its issuance dialog. Active saved keys can also be revealed or copied in Account & API keys. For PaaS, open an enabled application from My applications; each hosted workspace keeps its own files. For IaaS, use the separate machine access page only after its lease is active.

items.title: Keep your work and evidence
items.text: Save workflows and download important results. Browser-local editor drafts are not the hosted workspace volume. Inspect usage and receipts; never send a raw key or provider credential with a support request.

blocks.title: One next step, not a bypass
blocks.text: Follow the displayed readiness blocker. A manual lease request waits for operator review; no fixed approval time is promised. Payment completion, a submitted request and a ready machine are different states.

For exact failures use error-reference. For SSH and expiry consequences use exclusive-machine-basics; for managed workspace persistence use comfyui-quickstart. These guides describe implemented contracts, not proof that every external provider is live.

pages.title: Use and safely leave a rented bare machine
pages.summary: Understand the bare-machine lifecycle, claim scoped connection details, verify SSH identity, and save data before expiry without mistaking a credential handoff window for the machine lease itself.
pages.audience: User with an approved exclusive-machine lease

items.title: Wait for active access
items.text: Select a published offer or submit your requirements through the authorized request path. The platform selects eligible capacity from policy and health; you do not type a physical node address. Manual requests need operator review; provisioning may still be pending after payment.

items.title: Claim and verify
items.text: Choose Redeem SSH access once the lease is active. Copy the connection command and host fingerprint from the details. Follow the short-lived certificate issuer instructions and compare the host fingerprint before connecting; never disable SSH host verification.

items.title: Use a local tunnel when needed
items.text: For a user-owned web application listening on loopback port 8181, use the portal tunnel command built from the issued host, port and username. Keep the SSH session open and open the local forwarded address. The command does not install or start an application, and does not expose a public port.

items.title: Download before ending access
items.text: Save required files before lease expiry or End access early. Expiry closes access and starts staged tenant-account/container/volume cleanup. This is neither an instant whole-disk wipe nor a backup service. Contact the operator before expiry to discuss continued access; no self-service machine-renewal button or guaranteed extension exists.

rows: Machine lease expiry
Access ends and tenant cleanup begins; export your work first.
Connection handoff validity
The time window for claiming connection information; it does not extend machine lifetime.
Workspace lease expiry
Model and hosted workspace access stop; retained workspace volume follows the deployment retention policy, not bare-machine cleanup.

blocks.title: Separate authorities
blocks.text: A model API allowance does not grant SSH. A machine lease does not automatically authorize every model alias. Managed inference nodes never acquire arbitrary user applications through this guide.

The connection details provide Copy SSH command, Copy host fingerprint and Copy tunnel command. Only paste these into your own trusted terminal after reviewing the destination. Clipboard permission failure does not mean the machine request failed.

pages.title: Open ComfyUI, save work and return
pages.summary: Use administrator-approved hosted ComfyUI as a WebIDE, keep workflows and results in the scoped workspace, and distinguish that delivery from a self-managed application on a rented bare machine.

items.title: Open your personal workspace
items.text: Sign in at /user/, select the intended organization and open an enabled ComfyUI application. Follow any workspace or model-readiness blocker; registration or a text API key alone does not enable video generation.

items.title: Use the supplied profile
items.text: Load the starter or saved workflow for this workspace's allowed model. The personal CPU editor can call its approved remote video provider; it does not require stopping a company's text service. Custom nodes and model providers are operator-reviewed.

items.title: Keep the original task
items.text: Submit once. In personal video profiles with a 视频任务 panel, use that durable task status and original-task recovery after reconnecting. A transient queue display or browser disconnect does not justify a duplicate submission.

items.title: Save and return
items.text: Download needed media and export the workflow JSON. Logout or a container restart does not delete the personal volume. Reopen the same authorized workspace to continue, subject to retention, expiry and explicit deletion.

Signed-in authorized personal workspace; files are scoped
The template supplied for that personal or delivery-bound profile.
http://suanli.kechuangfuwu.com:5005/
Anonymous shared public workspace; workflows and files are public
Native H3 templates on the current public engine. Refresh old tabs; the former /h3/v1/ vLLM graph is retired.

blocks.title: Choose privacy before uploading
blocks.text: The public native H3 workspace requires no LunaNexa or Comfy Cloud login. Its shared files are not personal storage. Do not upload private material, and do not paste personal keys into a public workflow. The authenticated personal workspace remains separate.

pages.title: What is 能源谷“创未来”生态街区?

blocks.text: Idempotency and ownership

Clients use a unique opaque workload ID and idempotency key per logical operation. While a workload is queued or running, a duplicate is rejected as WorkloadAlreadyActive. With workspace enforcement, durable admission state binds status and cancellation to the original authenticated subject and tenant.
Streaming and failure semantics

items: Streaming is bounded and rejects truncated completion rather than pretending success.
Alternate-node failover is allowed only before the first output is delivered.
Caller cancellation becomes CancelledByCaller.
Queue or runtime deadline expiry becomes non-retryable DeadlineExceeded.
Adapter loss becomes RuntimeUnavailable with retryability derived from the failure class.

blocks.title: Declared size is not trusted
blocks.text: Workspace admission measures UTF-8 bytes of canonical payload JSON and requires the actual size to fit both the request ceiling and lease limit.

blocks.answer: Once output reaches the caller, retrying on another node could duplicate or contradict visible results. Pre-output retry preserves one logical response boundary.
